title: Supplementary
description: Provide additional information related to other warning signs

questions.question: A supplementary sign that indicates the recommended driving speed under normal weather conditions.
The When Wet supplementary sign is used together with the Slippery Road warning sign to remind drivers to slow down during wet conditions.
The ____________________ sign gives additional information about roadwork or intersections located along a side road.

matchingPairs.meaning: Shows the preferred maximum speed under normal traffic conditions.
Used with the Slippery Road sign to caution drivers in wet conditions.
Indicates the distance to the next hazard or affected section.
Provides added information about roadworks or intersections along a side road.

title: Tourist Information and Tourist Destination
description: Show directions or information about tourist spots.

options: Tourist Information and Tourist Destination Sign
questions.question: A brown guide sign that directs motorists toward historical and tourist destinations such as landmarks or museums.
Tourist Information and Tourist Destination Signs are typically brown with white text and are used to identify points of interest.
The ____________________ sign informs drivers of a scenic viewing area or lookout point, such as Scenic Lookout 300 m on Right.
The ____________________ sign indicates the direction to a natural attraction such as Taal Lake.

title: Fingerboard Direction
description: Show road or street names that motorists are passing or entering.

options: Intersection Direction Sign with route number and road name
Reassurance Direction Sign with route number and road name
questions.question: A sign used to point toward a specific destination such as a city, town, or tourist attraction
Fingerboard and Direction Signs provide information about road hazards and speed limits.
The ____________________ sign shows how far a driver is from key destinations along the current route.

options: Reassurance Direction Sign with route number and road name
questions.question: A sign that displays the name of a road or street a driver is entering or currently traveling on.
Street Name Signs are primarily used to warn motorists of upcoming intersections or curves.
The ____________________ sign provides the name of the street or avenue that a driver is approaching or crossing.

title: Start and End of Expressway Signs
description: These signs are installed to inform motorists of the beginning or end of an expressway section, ensuring proper speed adjustment and driving behavior.

options: End of Expressway XX KM Sign
questions.question: This sign informs motorists that the expressway begins.
The END EXPRWAY 2 km sign is installed after leaving the expressway.
A green sign that indicates the expressway will end after a distance of ________.
A green sign with the words ________ EXPRWAY, placed at the end of the expressway.

title: Reassurance Direction
description: Indicate the direction and approximate distance after intersections.

options: Reassurance Direction Sign with route number and road name
Intersection Direction Sign with route number and road name
questions.question: A sign that informs drivers about the remaining distance to major destinations such as cities or provinces.
The Reassurance Direction Sign with route number and road name includes both the highway identification and distance information for upcoming destinations.
The ____________________ sign shows how far a driver is from key destinations along the current route.

questions.correctAnswer: Reassurance Direction Sign with route number and road name
questions.question: The ____________________ sign displays the route number or highway name together with distance information.

title: Advance Direction
description: Indicate the direction(s) a motorist should take before an intersection.

questions.question: A guide sign that displays several destinations on one panel to help motorists determine the proper route before an intersection.
Diagrammatic Direction Sign (for roundabout) provides visual lane guidance for approaching a rotunda or circular junction.
The ____________________ sign includes the name of the road or street along with directional guidance for motorists.

matchingPairs.meaning: Stack Direction Sign (multiple destinations)
Stack Direction Sign (single destination)
Stack Direction Sign (with road/street name)
Diagrammatic Direction Sign

title: Traverse Lines
description: Placed across the road to regulate movement at intersections, pedestrian crossings, and roundabouts.

questions.question: These lines mark a pedestrian crossing at intersections with traffic signals.
Stop lines are placed before pedestrian crossings or intersections to control vehicle stopping positions.
A white line drawn across lanes indicating where vehicles must ________ at intersections or signals.

matchingPairs.meaning: Indicates where vehicles must stop before an intersection or crossing
Requires drivers to yield to oncoming traffic
Pedestrian crossing without traffic lights
Vehicles inside the roundabout have the right-of-way

title: Horizontal
description: Indicate the type of road curve ahead

questions.question: A road sign that warns drivers of a series of continuous curves ahead requiring reduced speed and caution
A Hairpin Bend warning sign indicates a very sharp change in direction on the road.
The ____________________ sign alerts motorists of two consecutive opposite turns ahead.

matchingPairs.meaning: Warns of a single sudden change in direction.
Alerts drivers of a very sharp U-shaped curve ahead.
Indicates two sharp bends in opposite directions.
Warns that the road has a series of continuous curves.

title: Expressway Service Signs
description: These signs provide distance and direction information to rest areas and various expressway services such as gas stations, restaurants, and service centers

questions.question: This sign provides information about the location where motorists can stop and rest.
Service center signs may include symbols for restaurants, fuel, and parking areas.
A blue sign used to guide motorists toward a rest area located 2 km ahead.
A blue sign that informs motorists about the availability of expressway services at the upcoming exit.

title: Miscellaneous
description: Signs that provide additional regulatory information not covered by other categories

options: No entry for vehicles with gross axle load of more than 2 tons
questions.question: Which sign reminds drivers to wear a seat belt as required by law?
No Blowing of Horns sign means that drivers are prohibited from using their horn in certain areas to avoid noise pollution.
The ____________________ sign indicates that a designated path or lane is provided for cyclists.

matchingPairs.meaning: Drivers must avoid honking in this area.
Reminds motorists to wear seat belts under R.A. 8750.
Warns drivers to watch for pedestrians on the road.
Vehicles exceeding 2 tons are not allowed to enter.

title: Object Markings
description: Used to alert drivers to physical obstructions or structures located on or near the roadway.

questions.question: These markings are applied to the edges of roadways or sidewalks to alert drivers and pedestrians of restricted zones or curbs.
Object markings are used only for movable obstructions such as cones.
Striped paint or markings found on the edge of sidewalks or medians are known as ________.
Reflective or high-visibility markings applied to barriers or structures near the roadway are called ________.

title: Longitudinal Lines
description: These markings provide additional guidance and regulation for specific types of road users and traffic conditions.

questions.question: This pavement marking allows passing or overtaking.
Continuity lines on the right side of the lane mean that the lane continues normally.
A ________ line indicates that passing is allowed.

matchingPairs.meaning: Divides lanes moving in the same direction; lane changes allowed
Passing or overtaking permitted
Overtaking allowed on one side only
Guides vehicles past obstructions or lane changes

title: Advance Exit Signs
description: Placed in advance of an exit

questions.question: This sign informs motorists that the Calamba Exit is 2 kilometers ahead.
The phrase NEXT EXIT sign is used on supplementary advance exit signs.
A green rectangular sign that reads Alabang NEXT EXIT.
A green sign that states Calamba EXIT 2 km is an ________.

title: Priority
description: Signs that inform road users of traffic laws and regulations which, if disregarded, will constitute an offense

questions.question: Driver must stop at designated STOP LINE. No parking within 6 meters.
You have the right of way when turning left at an intersection only if you signal at least 30 meters before and yield to approaching vehicles.
The driver must yield to vehicles on the right side of the intersection.
The driver turning left must yield to vehicles going straight or turning right.

title: Expressway Information Signs
description: These signs provide regulatory and directional information to ensure safe and efficient use of expressways.

questions.question: This sign prohibits bicycles, low cc motorcycles, and similar vehicles from entering the expressway.
Lane Direction signs help guide motorists to the proper lanes before an interchange.
A sign that displays the amount payable for different types of vehicles.
A green rectangular sign stating Prohibited on ________ that restricts certain vehicles.

title: Expressway Traffic Instruction and Regulatory Signs
description: These signs are used to regulate traffic movement and ensure compliance with expressway rules, including lane use, speed limits, and vehicle restrictions.

questions.question: This sign instructs drivers to immediately lower their speed.
Reduce Speed Now signs are only placed after the toll plaza.
A black and white sign stating RIGHT LANE ________ MERGE LEFT
A red rectangular sign advising drivers to STOP AT ________ GATES.

title: Movement Instruction
description: Tells drivers how they should navigate their vehicle through specific situations on the road by providing directions, rules, or mandatory commands.

questions.question: This sign instructs drivers to slow down to ensure safety, especially before curves or intersections.
No Through Road sign means the road leads to a dead end.
A sign that informs motorists that the road ahead is closed to all traffic.

matchingPairs.meaning: Advises drivers to slow down for safety
Prohibits turning right while traffic signal is red
Directs slower vehicles to stay in the right lane

title: Service Signs
description: Indicate available services like hospitals, gas stations, or parking areas.

options: Service Sign (with name of service, symbols, and distance)
questions.question: A sign that shows the location, distance, and symbols of available facilities such as gas stations or restaurants.
Service Signs are typically blue with white symbols to easily identify public services or facilities.
The ____________________ sign shows a gas pump symbol, representing a place where fuel is available.

matchingPairs.meaning: Indicates the location of a medical or first-aid facility.
Shows the area where vehicles can refuel.
Displays a symbol for designated parking spaces.
Indicates an area for weighing vehicles along highways

title: Pedestrian
description: Warns drivers to be cautious of pedestrians, children, or persons with disabilities crossing.

questions.question: A warning sign reminding drivers to slow down because pedestrians may be crossing ahead.
The Bicycle Lane Ahead sign informs drivers that the road is for motor vehicles only and cyclists are not allowed.
The ____________________ sign alerts drivers to slow down because children may be crossing the road ahead.

matchingPairs.meaning: Warns that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.
Alerts drivers of school children crossing the road.
Indicates a crossing area for persons with disabilities.
Warns drivers to slow down and be aware of cyclists.

title: Town Names and Geographical Feature
description: Show general information such as boundaries or landmarks.

questions.question: A sign that indicates the name of the town or city a driver is entering or leaving.
Town Names & Geographical Feature Signs identify administrative or geographic areas, not regulatory instructions.
The ____________________ sign indicates a natural or physical landmark, like LAGUNA DE BAY.

matchingPairs.meaning: Displays the name of the town being entered or exited.
Indicates the name of the province along the route.
Identifies a natural or geographical landmark.
Marks the border between two cities or municipalities.

title: Railway Level Crossing
description: Warns of railway tracks or crossings where vehicles must stop or proceed with caution.

questions.question: A warning sign that reminds motorists to stop at the designated line or proceed carefully when approaching railway tracks.
Alternative Railway Crossing sign indicates that the crossing area is positioned in a location that offers clear visibility for drivers.
The ____________________ sign advises drivers to stop, look, and listen before crossing the railroad tracks.
The ____________________ sign indicates that a different or alternative railway crossing is located in an area that can be easily seen by approaching drivers.

title: Supplementary
description: These signs provide additional instructions or information to drivers and pedestrians, usually placed below a main sign to clarify specific action

questions.question: This sign informs pedestrians to cross only at the designated crosswalk.
Trucks Use Low Gear helps prevent brake failure on downhill slopes.
A regulatory sign that instructs pedestrians to cross safely using the designated overpass rather than the roadway.

matchingPairs.meaning: Advises pedestrians to cross using the footbridge
Directs pedestrians to cross at a designated crosswalk
Reminds truck drivers to shift gear on steep downhill roads
Instructs motorists to ensure their brakes are working

title: Advance Warning / Traffic Control Device
description: Warns of the presence of traffic signals, stop, or give way signs ahead.

questions.question: A warning sign that alerts drivers of an approaching signalized intersection where parking or stopping within six (6) meters is prohibited
The Traffic Lights Ahead sign also reminds drivers to park or continue within six (5) meters of the sign to maintain visibility for other motorists.
The ____________________ sign warns drivers that a stop regulatory sign is placed ahead and they must prepare to stop.
The ____________________ sign alerts motorists that a give regulatory sign is coming up and they must be ready to yield.

title: Other Markings
description: These markings provide additional guidance and regulation for specific types of road users and traffic conditions.

questions.question: Commonly known as __________, these raised reflectors guide drivers by marking lanes and road edges.
This pavement marking warns drivers of a nearby train crossing.
Bus Lane markings help ensure buses travel in designated lanes.
A large number marking on the road reminding motorists of maximum allowable speed

matchingPairs.meaning: Directs drivers into turning lanes separated by an island
Produces noise/vibration to warn inattentive drivers
Marks lanes designated for public buses only
Reminds motorists of the maximum speed limit

title: Parking and Stopping
description: Signs that regulate where vehicles may or may not park, stop, load, or unload

questions.question: Which sign means that no vehicle is allowed to stop and subject to be towed?

The ____________________ sign tells drivers that parking is prohibited, but temporary loading or unloading is allowed.

matchingPairs.meaning: Drivers must not stay idle or wait in the designated area.
Parking is prohibited during weekdays.
Temporary stopping is allowed only for loading or unloading.
Vehicles must not stop or park at any time.

title: Other Warning Signs
description: Include special or situational warnings.

questions.question: A warning sign that indicates the maximum vertical clearance height allowed for vehicles passing under a bridge or structure.
The Slow Down Accident Prone Area sign is used to inform drivers that the section of the road has a lower clearance height.
The ____________________ sign warns that the lane ahead will end and motorists must merge safely to the left.

matchingPairs.meaning: Indicates the maximum vertical height allowed for vehicles.
Warns drivers to reduce speed in accident-prone zones.
Alerts motorists of merging lanes that require caution.
Indicates that the right lane is ending and vehicles must merge left.

title: Route Markers
description: Identify route numbers of highways and their directions.

questions.question: A sign that shows the route number of a national highway and helps drivers follow the correct direction.
All route marker signs are circular in shape and use blue symbols.
The ____________________ sign shows the number assigned to a national or arterial highway, such as Route 95 or Route 52.
The ____________________ post indicates the distance in kilometers from the Zero Kilometer Post, such as KM 340 D.

title: Roadwork Signs
description: These signs are used to warn and guide drivers and pedestrians when roadworks or maintenance activities are being carried out.

questions.question: This sign warns that construction or maintenance workers are on or near the roadway.
Do Not Enter signs are used to instruct drivers to proceed slowly through work zones.
A red-bordered circular sign displaying __________ means vehicles are prohibited from entering the area.

matchingPairs.meaning: Warns that workers are on or near the road
Prohibits entry into the construction or restricted area
Instructs motorists to reduce speed near roadwork zones
Alerts drivers to open pits or deep digging ahead

title: Prohibitive / Restrictive
description: Signs that prohibit or restrict certain types of vehicles or maneuvers on the road

questions.question: Which sign means that no vehicle of any type is allowed to enter?
The No Overtaking Zone sign allows overtaking only during light traffic conditions.
The ____________________ sign means pedestrians must not cross the roadway.

matchingPairs.meaning: Vehicles are not allowed to turn left
Vehicles are not allowed to make a U-turn
NO OVERTAKING ZONE
Vehicles are not allowed to turn right.

title: Directional
description: These signs indicate the direction(s) in which the motorist is obliged to follow

questions.question: Which of the following signs means that vehicles are allowed to pass on either side?

The ____________________ sign tells drivers that turning in any direction is not allowed.

matchingPairs.meaning: Vehicles must keep to the left side of the road.
Traffic is allowed to move in only one direction.
Drivers must prepare to turn right at the next intersection.
Two traffic lanes will join ahead; proceed with caution.

title: Expressway Approach Signs
description: Installed in advance or at the nearest intersection or interchange leading to the expressway

questions.question: This sign indicates the direction leading to the North Luzon Expressway.
The phrase To Expressway may appear on signs located before an interchange.

A green rectangular sign with white text that says To ______ Expressway.

title: Intersection Direction
description: Placed before intersections to guide drivers to desired destinations.

options: Intersection Direction Sign with route number and road name
questions.question: A guide sign that points to the right, showing the direction to a city or province located in that direction.

matchingPairs.meaning: Indicates destinations or routes to the right side of an intersection.
Indicates destinations located to the left side of an intersection.
Shows destinations pointing in both directions.

title: Road Width
description: Alerts drivers about narrowing roads, bridges, or divided roads ahead.

questions.question: A warning sign that informs motorists the roadway will become narrower ahead, requiring reduced speed and caution.

The ____________________ sign indicates that the highway will soon be separated into two carriageways.

matchingPairs.meaning: Indicates the end of the divided section of the road
Shows that the road will divide into two separate carriageways.
Indicates the bridge ahead is narrower than the road approach.
Warns that the road ahead will become narrower.

title: Expressway Exit Direction Signs
description: Signs posted overhead before the exit ramp of an interchange for directions.

questions.question: A green EXIT sign that includes a white box for an exit number.
Exit direction signs are placed after the exit ramp to show the way out.
A green sign with a blank white box for numbering.
A rectangular green sign with NEXT _______ 15 km.

title: Road Obstacles
description: Warns of physical hazards like humps, uneven roads, or landslide-prone areas.

questions.question: A warning sign that alerts drivers of a raised section of pavement where vehicles must reduce speed.

The ____________________ sign warns motorists that the road ahead may be temporarily covered by water due to flooding.

matchingPairs.meaning: Alerts motorists that aircraft may fly at low altitude near the road.
Warns drivers of possible falling rocks or soil.
Indicates a steep downward slope requiring reduced speed.
Warns of a bridge that may open to allow watercraft passage.

title: Speed
description: Signs that indicate the maximum, minimum, or end of speed restrictions on a given road or area.

questions.question: Which sign indicates the fastest speed a driver is legally allowed to travel?

matchingPairs.meaning: Warns that another lane of vehicles will join the traffic flow ahead.
Alerts motorists that a junction is near and to reduce speed.

A hazard sign that alerts drivers to an approaching change in road alignment or curvature.
Two-Way Hazard Markers are used only for pedestrian crossings.

matchingPairs.meaning: Warns of narrowing lanes or clearance reduction
Guides drivers through horizontal curves
